outline: 本課程教導學生瞭解管理會計的技巧與成本管理的觀念。在介紹過營收報表、損益平衡表、現金流動表後，本課程將探討資產管理、資金結構、資金運轉、創投資金、股息策略、利潤分析等議題。課程中亦將論及利用這些財務數據做為決策根據的作法。
schedule:
第一週：課程整體簡介、由企業卓越與失敗洞悉財務舞弊、基本會計循環與財務報表介紹
第二週：Financial Statement Introduction、財務報表分析及實例探討
第三週：管理會計概念介紹、Tools for Planning and Control、成本習性分析
第四週：Cost Information for Decisions、Cost Definition and CVP Analysis
第五週：分批與分步成本制
第六週：變動成本制、企業財務分析報告(分組)
第七週：Strategic Investment Decision and Management Control Systems、Profitability Analysis and Planning
第八週：Target Costing and Price Planning、Budgeting
第九週：利潤規劃、Profitability Analysis of Strategic Business Segments)
第十週：標準成本制、Activity Cost Analysis and Planning
第十一週：金融環境、金融工具簡介、利率之決定因素、概論：財務管理的範圍、財務人員的功能、股東價值創造、代理問題、公司治理、市場效率性
第十二週：權益及負債證券之特性與類型、股票及債券之評價模式
第十三週：Balanced Scorecard & Strategy Maps、Performance Measurement, Compensation and Multinational Considerations
第十四週：現金流量折現技術暨其在財務問題之用
第十五週：報酬與風險的關係、資本資產訂價模式
第十六週：股票基礎觀念與評價、債劵觀念
第十七週：企業財務個案報告(分組)、期末報告
scorePolicy:
平常 40%
期中考 30%
報告 30%

哈佛個案:
Case1: Swatch
1. Why was the Swatch so successful? In what ways was the Swatch different than any watch the industry had ever seen?
2. What elements of the original Swatch marketing plan were most critical to the brand’s success? Do you agree with the original product strategy? the channel strategy? The promotional strategy? What about the pricing strategy—what does Franco Bosisio mean when he says that the Swatch is sold at a “clean price”? Given the huge demand for Swatches (particularly for certain models), did the company make a mistake in not raising the price for some of its styles?
3. Prior to the introduction of the Swatch, what kinds of watches were popular among consumers? In what ways was a Rolex different from a Timex, or from a gold-plated Seiko? How did consumers make buying decisions?

Case2: Cola-wars
1: Why is the soft drink industry so profitable?
2: Compare the economics of the concentrate business to the bottle business: why is the profitability so different?
3: How has the competition between Coke and Pepsi affected the industry’s profit?
4: Can Coke and Pepsi sustain their profits in the wake of flattening demand and the glowing popularity in non-carbonated drink?
